week.headline: The NFELO model and Vegas are 18.5 percentage points apart on Dallas at Indianapolis.

rest.headline: San Francisco projects to 12.9 wins, the most in the league.
rest.note: Projected wins = wins so far + half a win per tie + the sum of the team's win probabilities in its remaining games.

playoff_odds.headline: Seattle's playoff chances fell the most this week, to 47%. San Francisco is the Super Bowl favorite at 12%.
